verdict.rationale: Figma's prototyping tools are explicitly documented as enabling high-fidelity, no-code, interactive prototypes (figma-docs-16, figma-docs-33), which directly matches the story of wiring screens with triggers/transitions/overlays. However, the evidence pack lacks detail on specific interaction elements like overlays or transition types, and there's no independent hands-on corroboration of the prototyping workflow itself (community evidence focuses on dev handoff/export pain points, not prototyping). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of overlay/trigger/transition mechanics, independent user validation of the prototyping experience specifically.
